title: Bad instructions
text: Bad instructions. I gave the teapot 3 stars because its smaller than i thought it would be (almond can for size reference) also the instructions arnt clear, it states you cant use it over open flame, on the stove top or in the microwave... Well how are you going to heat your water? Hmm.... If i was to heat my water in something else then put it in this teapot then whats the point of the teapot? I bought it because its cute and cast iron, so i can take it camping and use it over open flame for when i dont have electricity and want coffee... i was looking at a teapot with sunflowers on it but it was glass and didnt think it would travel well. I havent used this teapot yet, lets hope it doesnt break when i use it for the intended reason i bought it for. Will review again after use.
